thresholds.description: Regression floors for the deterministic offline golden evaluator. Calibrated to the CURRENT system's measured baseline (bench/results/offline_eval_v1.json) minus a small margin, so the baseline passes with headroom while a real regression trips. Invariant metrics (citation resolution, forbidden-sources clean) are held at their measured value; noisy means get a slightly larger margin. The evaluator exits non-zero on any violation.

calibration.rule: floor = measured_actual - margin (see per-metric note in the accompanying OFFLINE_EVAL_v1.md)
calibration.margin_policy: invariants: 0.0; rates: 0.05; means: ~10-15% below actual; quality/relevance: ~8 points / 0.05
